The file

The Prowling Purrpetrators are the only team in the neighborhood Inspector Clueso has never caught. He has been trying for five cases. The file contains: nothing. The file is very thick. Clueso says the thickness is the point.

The pink team operates a full newsroom, a hotline, a newsletter, and a Corrections Desk. Clueso has noted that a team this busy is either extremely innocent or extremely guilty, and he has chosen 'extremely guilty' because 'extremely innocent' does not make a good headline.

No pink prank has been reported, photographed, posted, or deleted. Clueso believes this is a masterclass in not being caught. Everyone else believes it is a masterclass in not doing anything. The truth is probably somewhere between. Clueso will not be taking questions.

The Purrpetrators decline to confirm or deny. They are, as always, wearing sunglasses.

Strengths

  • An extremely good logo.
  • A newsroom, a hotline, and a newsletter, all on one team.
  • Sunglasses.

Weaknesses

  • Clueso.
  • Clueso, again.
  • Every other team has a case file. They have a feeling.

Clueso's advice

Prank someone. Anyone. Clueso is begging. He would like to be right.

— Inspector Clueso, PNN
